title: Tim Taylor disappears after 15 years of contact

tellings.quote: He just disappeared. We never heard from him since.

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor stayed in touch with Charles Hall and his wife for about fifteen years and then, they say, simply vanished from their lives, sometime after 2000 in New Mexico. Hall is a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force base in Nevada, and it is his wife, speaking from her own experience, who tells it: "He just disappeared. We never heard from him since."
